hook.say: Turkey's ten biggest football stadiums, ranked. Four of them are in Istanbul!

outro.say: Which team do you support? Comment below!

items.name: Samsun 19 Mayıs
items.say: Number ten: Samsoon Stadium, home of Samsoon-spor. 34300 seats.
items.cap: Number ten: Samsun Stadium, home of Samsunspor. 34,300 seats.

items.name: Kocaeli Stadium
items.say: Nine: Ko-jah-elly Stadium, home of Ko-jah-elly-spor. 34800 seats.
items.cap: Nine: Kocaeli Stadium, home of Kocaelispor. 34,800 seats.

items.name: Şenol Güneş
items.fact: Built on land won from the sea
items.say: Eight: Shennol Goonesh, built on reclaimed land. 41000 seats.
items.cap: Eight: Şenol Güneş, built on reclaimed land. 41,000 seats.

items.name: Konya Stadium
items.say: Seven: Konya Stadium, home of Konyaspor. 41600 seats.
items.cap: Seven: Konya Stadium, home of Konyaspor. 41,600 seats.

items.name: Beşiktaş Stadium
items.say: Six: Beshiktash Stadium, right on the Bosphorus. 42700 seats.
items.cap: Six: Beşiktaş Stadium, right on the Bosphorus. 42,700 seats.

items.name: Centennial Atatürk
items.say: Five: Bursa's Ataturk, shaped like a giant crocodile. 43400 seats.
items.cap: Five: Bursa's Atatürk, shaped like a giant crocodile. 43,400 seats.

items.name: Şükrü Saracoğlu
items.say: Four: Shookroo Sarajoh-loo, home of Fener-bahchay. 47400 seats.
items.cap: Four: Şükrü Saracoğlu, home of Fenerbahçe. 47,400 seats.

items.name: İzmir Atatürk
items.say: Three: Izmeer Ataturk, open since nineteen seventy-one. 51300 seats.
items.cap: Three: İzmir Atatürk, open since nineteen seventy-one. 51,300 seats.

items.name: Rams Park
items.say: Two: Rams Park, home of Galatasaray. 54000 seats.
items.cap: Two: Rams Park, home of Galatasaray. 54,000 seats.

items.name: Atatürk Olympic
items.say: And number one: the Ataturk Olympic Stadium! 77600 seats, host of two Champions League finals.
items.cap: And number one: the Atatürk Olympic Stadium! 77,600 seats, host of two Champions League finals.
